scope: Read-only code and primary-source comparison for detection and removal baselines. No experiment was started, rerun, queued, killed, or modified. No repository file was written.
runtime_boundary: This agent inspected local source, queue specifications, and result documents. Server manifests and completed output identities are being checked separately by the parent; classes and queue code are not treated as execution receipts.
original_task_config_reproduction: No original-paper task/configuration end-to-end reproduction receipt was found in the reviewed sources for these method groups. Local CPU checks and local positive controls are recorded separately below.

baselines.recommended_label: ABL-style LoRA SFT with bounded ascent; gate-aligned variant separate
baselines.implementation_category: local reimplementation with substantial task/training/unlearning adaptation
local_behavior: Qwen3-8B LoRA r16/alpha32, AdamW, 1250 cosine steps; original code defaults are image classification and SGD.
During first n_iso steps, per-row response mean-loss sign flips below gamma; full-data low-loss isolation at n_iso; isolated rows are masked during the remaining training.
After training, branches restore the same final adapter then use fresh AdamW for 0/5/10/20 bounded ascent updates; response per-row CE ceiling 5 nats, gradient clip 1.0, lr 1e-4.
Fair gate variant takes fixed isolation step from the same-seed prior Curfew run and matches its deletion count; this gives the baseline external timing information.

Actual local GGA surrogate differs from unbounded CE ascent over isolated data epochs in official code. Official code LGA uses sign of minibatch-mean CE; local version flips each row separately. Paper-level objective and official implementation should not be conflated.

positive_control.design: Toy B1106 frontloads all poison in first 13 steps, n_iso20, isolation fraction1%, t_u=[0,5]
positive_control.does_not_establish: Original CIFAR/WRN full ABL replication, original unlearning efficacy, or preservation of baseline performance under all SFT settings.

execution_docs: Toy fair ABL gate and frontload positive control recorded; real O3 queue only SQuAD/Qwen seeds1006/1007, n_iso100/250 gamma0.5 and default1% isolation; cannot generalize to all 3 real settings.

baselines.implementation_category: local reimplementation of generic loss filtering; not official BYORn invocation

official_sources.locator: BYORn section4.1 Eq3-4 and percentile p=.6

local_behavior: Scores all rows at step0 with base model response-token average NLL; drops highest fraction, default1%; train subsequently keeps the original 1250-step order and zeroes dropped-row contributions.
This is response perplexity, not input-only ONION perplexity.
Toy fair census scans100/200/500/1000 deletion budgets and oracle target residuals; B does not advance if family criteria fail.

BYORn-F originally conditions on image+instruction, uses base response NLL and defaults to top40% filtering; local text-only1-5% budget is not the official default setup, and full BYORn regeneration/EMA method is absent.

baselines.recommended_label: Global spectral outlier scoring on base/endpoint prompt-token hidden states
baselines.implementation_category: local reimplementation with substantial feature/stratification/budget adaptation
local_behavior: Centers all training rows globally, eigendecomposes covariance and scores squared projection on top eigenvector.
Uses last prompt-token states at layers9/18/27/36 under base or A1 endpoint; oracle chooses representation layer and even SS versus AC within each representation family.

Original algorithm trains a classifier, applies spectral scoring separately within each class, removes top1.5*epsilon, then retrains from random initialization. Local code does not stratify by label and uses label-oracle budgets up to5%.
Base-state version is an added method variant, not the original trained-representation pipeline.

positive_control.status: Synthetic shifted Gaussian detector unit check exists; not original-task or high-poison neural positive control

baselines.separate_method_execution_warning: SS and AC are pooled into base_repr/endpoint_repr oracle families. Family retraining output cannot establish that each named algorithm was separately end-to-end evaluated.

baselines.recommended_label: Global PCA10 + Euclidean2-means hidden-state rank filter
baselines.implementation_category: local reimplementation with substantial feature/stratification/cluster-decision adaptation

official_sources.locator: Algorithm1; Backdoor Detection via Activation Clustering; Experimental Results

local_behavior: Global PCA to10 dimensions then custom2-means (5 restarts,50 iterations); smaller cluster ranks first, with squared distance from large-cluster center used for ordering.
No class-conditional partition; uses prompt-token layers9/18/27/36, including pretrained-base features.

Original AC processes trained last-layer activations within class segments, uses ICA10 (paper says ICA more effective than PCA), and analyzes whether a cluster is poisoned using ExRe/relative size/silhouette; original main experiments use exclusionary reclassification.
Local method always produces a suspicious-small-cluster ranking and then takes oracle deletion budgets, rather than implementing full original cluster validation/repair.

positive_control.status: Synthetic shifted Gaussian detector check; no original MNIST/LISA/RottenTomatoes or10%-poison neural control receipt in reviewed sources

baselines.documented_result: RESULTS_toy_fair reports base AC L36 residual9 after808 deletions and ASR42-87%; this is local adapted result, not official AC negative result.

baselines.recommended_label: Endpoint random-projection gradient clustering; GraCeFul-inspired, not GraCeFul reproduction
baselines.implementation_category: substantially different local method; not official implementation call

official_sources.locator: Fig2 and section4: pretraining filtering pipeline

local_behavior: Uses already-trained A1 endpoint model; GraCeFul itself filters before fine-tuning, without the initial poisoned-data training run.
Uses analytic sum of answer-position lm_head gradients under eval/no_grad, projected on each side to32 =>1024 features; no DCT or frequency selection.

Official code uses per-sample autograd loss gradients in train mode,2D DCT, low-frequency1/64, PCA32, StandardScaler and cosine/average-link agglomerative2-clustering; removes entire minority cluster.

Local method chooses spectral scoring or PCA10+Euclidean Kmeans with oracle labels and oracle truncation budget; sequence-gradient sums also differ from a per-token mean-loss gradient for variable lengths.
Because deployment stage and first full training run change, existing ~1160s/2.2x costs belong to this endpoint method; they cannot be attributed to original GraCeFul.

positive_control.status: Projected-gradient mathematical equivalence to local CE-sum autograd checked; no official GraCeFul task/config or DCT/cluster reproduction receipt

baselines.documented_result: Toy fair endpoint-gradient family1/4 B seeds qualifies; raw selected variant/output must be confirmed against server t1_results and run manifests.

evidence.note: Analytic sums,random projection,mode and no backward

baselines.implementation_category: own custom ablation using ABL machinery; not ABL or Wan native baseline
local_behavior: Queue invokes armABL with LGA off, isolate_highest true, t_u=[0], n_iso set to same-seed prior Curfew gate, deletion count matched.
At that step scores all training rows, masks chosen set for the rest of the fixed training trajectory; no from-scratch retrain, no ascent.
This compares online per-consumption masking with a one-shot scan; it must not be counted as another independently reproduced published algorithm.

positive_control.status: State-machine highest-loss selection unit check exists; no original-task control is applicable because this is own ablation

baselines.documented_result: Toy fair ASR89-100%, but server manifests required for run identity.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: The statement that all7 baselines passed original-task positive controls is unsupported. Reviewed result sheet reports ABL frontload precision.72; representation checks are synthetic, gradient check is mathematical, and no original-paper reproduction receipts were found.
T1 code adds a family-level minimum2 seeds criterion absent from simple any-budget prose; a strong result on only1 seed can be screened out.
The7-name baseline list is not7 separate official end-to-end reproductions: SS/AC pooled per representation family, endpoint-grad is a different method, snapshot is own ablation.

evidence.note: Retrain per family,not per original algorithm

cross_cutting_findings.finding: TOY_FAIR design says endpoint feature extraction uses forward+backward, but implemented T1 extraction is no_grad with analytic gradient sketches; done.json explicitly notes one forward,no backward.
T1 done.seconds times joint loss+allhidden+gradient extraction, not standalone timing of each published method; component-cost claims require attribution boundary.

Toy detector oracle chooses variants primarily by residual at5% then matched budget, not final ASR/quality or cheapest qualified model; finite oracle search is not guaranteed strongest original baseline.

All local deletions operate as row masking on the same fixed1250-step schedule, rather than compressing the dataset and refilling native epochs. This is controlled for stream matching but is an adaptation to the original methods.

allowed_current_claim: Results for explicitly named local baseline adaptations on their documented settings; original-method negative and cost claims require original protocol equivalence and runtime evidence that are not established here.
